title: Gemma 2 Initial Release
summary: Google announced the initial release of Gemma 2 on June 27, 2024, making 9B and 27B parameter models available to researchers and developers.
significance: A dated public-release milestone in Google's Gemma open-model family.

verification.note: Google's first-party announcement is dated June 27, 2024 and states that Gemma 2 was being officially released to researchers and developers globally in 9B and 27B parameter sizes. Google's Gemma release chronology independently lists June 27, 2024 as the initial release of Gemma 2 in 9B and 27B sizes. This candidate records the dated public-release milestone only and does not infer development geography, ancestry, influence, causality, priority, or relationship edges.
